structural_observations: Two competitors (Cadence Clinical, Otoscribe) already occupy the 'specialty-tuned, not horizontal' position. It is a contested position, not an empty one.
Per-specialty fine-tuning is shipped by at least one funded competitor since 2025.
The two shutdowns in the last 24 months were both sub-$15M-raised entrants that could not fund a sales motion against the leaders.
No player has achieved above 6% share of the 5+ clinician segment. The field is crowded but nobody has won.
